changes: Add temporal automatic update/default and spatial SRID column attributes
Add ALTER repartitioning and full subpartition definitions; semantic alter_action naming
Expose primary column operations as top-level cases

Add ADD PARTITION PARTITIONS count for HASH/KEY tables
Require explicit SUBPARTITION KEY column list while retaining PARTITION KEY() inference
Add canonical leading ALGORITHM/LOCK options to standalone partition operations; DISCARD/IMPORT use DEFAULT only
